title: Oven Roasted Japanese Chicken Ozoni
description: A weeknight Japanese dish featuring roasted chicken in a sour cream and shio-koji cure sauce, served in a traditional ozoni form. This diabetic-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together shio-koji, sour cream, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the chicken in a single layer.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 25 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the ozoni bowls by placing a small amount of chicken broth in the bottom of each bowl.
Once the chicken is cooked, remove it from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes.
To assemble the ozoni, place a few pieces of the roasted chicken in each bowl, then garnish with green onions and mitsuba.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
